scientific_integrity: The spectral decomposition and dissipative limit are proved in RESULT.md; the finite checks are corroboration rather than proof. Existing exact SSH eigenmodes and qualitative opposite-sublattice dark-mode protection are credited as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Finite odd, open, disorder-free SSH chains; positive real alternating hoppings; exact infinitely long no-detection dynamics; specified absorber subsets. No uniform finite-time rate or robustness claim. The open 2014 odd-chain spectrum paper has been inspected for relevant material; independent publication-priority verification has not occurred.
title: Sublattice-selective absorption laws for odd dimerized quantum chains
